a: The byte-bound downshift ignores the ring and the level above, so a tight `maxBytes` evicts and rebakes them every frame and `pending` never reaches 0
A throwing `release` or `onError` callback skips `done()`, so the load's entry stays in `loading` and holds a concurrency slot forever
`planeFloor` can return two tiles a side when `floorTiles` is 1, although its doc promises at most `floorTiles`
b: A bake answering null counts as baked, so `pending` can read 0 while that tile is still wanted
A floor that alone breaks the byte bound drives the level down to -64
A tile that arrives fading in drops the finer stand-ins it was drawn with a frame earlier
Rebaking a tile mid-fade cuts its fade short
`planeFloor` with `floorTiles = 1` returns up to two tiles a side
